title: To Rescue a Jedi
front_description: Although all the Jedi are greatly concerned about Obi-Wan's safety, Mace Windu orders Anakin to stay where he is and watch over Senator Amidala...his first priority. Padmé reasons that it'll take too long for a Coruscant rescue mission to get to Geonosis, and she decides to go after Obi-Wan herself. "If you plan to protect me," Padmé tells Anakin, "you'll just have to come along."
back_description: Ewan McGregor is suspended by wires for the Geonosian prison sequence
